map.边界品位和工业品位有什么区别？: What is the difference between the cut-off grade and the industrial grade?
map.边界品位是圈定矿体、划分矿石与废石的最低品位标准；工业品位（最低工业品位）用于区: The cut-off grade is the minimum grade standard for delineating an ore body and separating ore from waste; the industrial grade (minimum industrial grade) distinguishes rich ore from marginal ore and is usually higher than the cut-off grade. Together they determine the boundary and economics of the mineable reserve.
